title: What I Said to Him
pages:
I did it. I walked in and I said his name, and for a moment it was the right name.

He looked at me and I saw him all the way down.

I could not hold him. I want to write that I chose to let go. I did not. He was simply stronger than whatever I had brought.

But he left. He did not finish what he came to do, and that is the only victory I have to report.

To whoever stood in that room with me: I am sorry I could not be gentler about it.

You were braver than the compass deserved. I am still holding mine.

I am going after him. Not to bring him home. I have stopped believing in home.

To see that he is somewhere the world cannot reach. To see that the seal holds.

The search continues. It always did.
